rule.title: Implementation slot can be updated without a strong upgrade guard

intent.attack_thesis: A storage slot recognized as an implementation slot can be written from an externally reachable path without a strong upgrade guard, enabling replacement of the future delegate target.

reporting.title_template: Implementation slot update is reachable without a strong upgrade guard
reporting.summary: Matches implementation-slot writes that are externally reachable without a strong admin, governance, or timelock guard.
reporting.user_summary: The proxy may allow an attacker to change its implementation address without proper upgrade authorization. If that happens, the attacker can replace the contract logic the proxy will run.
reporting.technical_summary: The detector matches externally reachable writes into a slot recognized as an ERC-1967 implementation slot when the write is user-controlled and not protected by a strong admin, governance, or timelock guard. That exposes the future delegate target to attacker influence.
reporting.exploit_narrative: The attacker calls an upgrade path that writes the proxy's implementation pointer without strong authorization. Once the implementation slot is replaced, subsequent proxy calls delegate into attacker-chosen code and the proxy's execution authority is lost.
exploit_preconditions: implementation slot controls future delegate target
attacker can choose or influence the replacement implementation
remediation_hints: guard upgrade entrypoints with explicit admin or governance authorization
use timelock or multisig review for upgrade execution
emit upgrade events and enforce implementation allowlists where appropriate

steps.action: call upgrade function passing attacker-controlled implementation address
steps.expected_state: EIP-1967 implementation slot updated to malicious contract address

witness_goal.success_condition: implementation slot contains attacker-controlled address; all future calls delegate to malicious contract
